She sketched it on the pad and began at the tail tip, while Leo took the belly and Priya the lower fin. Early on, the plan had the fin closing back onto the tip. Tom checked each joint as it landed. Once the belly was down, he said, "Fork looks good from here." When Priya's fin went on, he confirmed the chain ran "from the start right through to the fin tip, nothing broken." Maya was still working on her top line, with the nose gap yet to fix, as the clock wound down.
